# Optional Gemini CLI use

Use the active host's MCP capabilities first. Gemini CLI is an optional external tool, not the primary MCP transport or a requirement for core workflows.

When the user chooses it, check `gemini --help` and its installed version, configure its own supported server/auth settings, and use a model available in that environment. Do not hardcode the session model or automatically copy/symlink Codex or Claude configuration into another host.

Return the actual operation result and identify any additional dependency or access failure. Never claim tools were called merely because the CLI returned prose. For current configuration, consult the [official Gemini CLI documentation](https://geminicli.com/docs) and [MCP server guide](https://geminicli.com/docs/tools/mcp-server).
